launchWithTabs.label: Warm start with 3 last tabs reopened (ms)

keyHtml.label: Key to both panels painted, normal page

keyLetter.label: Key to the letter painted in the code (two frames, plus up to 3 ms of timer jitter)

keyBurst.label: Fast typing, a key every second frame: frames over 20 ms (%)

keyLong.label: Key to both panels painted, 400-line page

keyHuge.label: Key to both panels painted, 5,000-line page (a slow page waits for a 0.2 s pause in typing)

keyHugeLetter.label: Typing on a 5,000-line page, keys 90 ms apart: key to the letter painted

codeScrollHuge.label: Scrolling the code of a 5,000-line page: frames over 20 ms (%)

keyCss.label: Key in CSS to both panels painted

tabSwitch.label: Tab switch, editor and preview painted

tabSwitchOtherProject.label: Switch to a tab of another project

helpSearchKey.label: Help search, per key (two frames, plus up to 3 ms of timer jitter)

dividerDrag.label: Divider drag, guide line frames over 20 ms (%)

dividerDrop.label: Divider let go: both panels painted at the new width

open3Files.label: Open a 3-file project, answer to painted

galleryOpen.label: Template gallery opens, first preview painted

galleryHover.label: Template gallery, mouse on a row to its preview painted

templateOpen.label: Open a template, answer to its home page painted

idleCpu.label: Idle CPU, whole app (% of one core)

memoryMb.label: Memory, all app processes (MB)
memoryMb.note: Measured after a 5,000-line page was opened and closed; 174 MB before that test existed

editorBundleKb.label: Editor bundle and the chunks it loads at start (KB)

editorAllKb.label: Editor bundle and all language chunks (KB)

appBundleMb.label: App bundle (MB)
appBundleMb.note: Raised from 20 to 30 for the full gallery of 42 templates, 2026-11-08; 15 before the gallery
